points: Your site offers 40% off Kähler Colore, but 0 of 8 ads mention it or any offer, so new buyers have no reason to act. Put the 40% offer in the first line of three new ads.

Your site gives delivery in 2 to 5 business days and free shipping from € 89, yet 0 of 8 ads mention either. Buyers pause on wait times before clicking. Open new-buyer ads with both facts in line one.
None of your 8 ads shows a proof number, so a new buyer has no count to trust before clicking. Collect one real figure, such as review count or orders shipped, and lead the next batch with it.
All 8 ads started within the last 17 days, so none has been kept long enough to build from. Keep one as the base and build three variations of it, changing only the opening line and the offer.
